title: Standalone auth deploy of RF-177/RF-178 (#703, #705), after RF-180 and with iOS RF-1012
acceptance: The owner has decided RF-180 (native sign-out Origin), and main carries that decision.

Deployed from the Air via deployment-runbook.md with the owner's explicit deploy permission, shipping main's auth changes (#703, #705, plus any RF-180 change) and nothing outside auth; HISTORY records the Worker version, rollback version and smoke results.

Post-deploy: POST /api/v1/auth/session on an aged session returns 200 with no Set-Cookie and extends the row; a sign-out from the shipped iOS client revokes the session, and sign-outs the RF-180 decision rejects are refused; browser sign-in and get-session refresh still work.

iOS RF-1012 (cookie with no client-side expiry, /auth/session at launch and foreground) ships to the owner's devices close to this deploy, since a pre-RF-1012 build keeps its 7-day client expiry and gets no refreshed cookie after option C.
nextAction: 1) Owner decides RF-180. 2) An iOS RF-1012 build is on the owner's devices (or ready to install). 3) Owner gives deploy permission on the Air.
